tasks.description: Remove the dist/ output directory so the next build starts from a clean slate.
Compile TypeScript to dist/ (skipping typecheck — that's a separate gate) and mark the bin executable.
Regenerate schema.json from the zod ConfigSchema source of truth.
Read-only Biome check (lint + format) across the repo.
Auto-fix Biome lint and formatting issues across the repo.
Auto-fix Biome lint and formatting issues for a single source file.
Type-check the project with tsgo (Microsoft's native TS preview) without emitting output.
Long-running tsgo watcher. Output streams into the log pane; kill with K to stop.
Default fallow run — detect unused exports and dead code.
Full fallow audit (dead code + duplicates + dependency health).
Run the full Vitest suite once (unit + e2e) in non-watch mode.
Run a single Vitest file, optionally filtered by test-name pattern.

tags.test: Quality gates run by CI: check, typecheck, fallow, test.

groups.build: Build artifacts: clean dist, compile to JS + chmod the bin, regenerate schema.
groups.lint: Biome lint + format (read-only check, repo-wide fix, single-file fix).
